div.p: P1 tickets decline from 42 to 15 and customer impact from 136 to 22 hours across six weekly checks after queue isolation. The decline tracks the mitigated period; it does not prove the retry governor alone caused recovery. The next deploy must retain per-tenant queue ceilings and compare the matched traffic cohort.
